headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[drives himself to inspect Dhaka city services]], orders immediate fixes
headline: PM Tarique Rahman drives himself to inspect Dhaka city services, orders immediate fixes
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman personally drove across Dhaka North City Corporation areas for over two and a half hours, identifying shortcomings in waste management, drainage, and greening. He expressed dissatisfaction and ordered prompt corrective actions fro
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman conducted an on-site inspection of waste management, drainage, greening, and other civic services across areas under Dhaka North City Corporation yesterday. He personally drove the vehicle for over two and a half hours to assess the conditions.

During his extensive tour, the Prime Minister identified several problems at different locations and expressed dissatisfaction with a number of issues. He promptly instructed the relevant authorities to take immediate and effective corrective measures.

Prior to the inspection, around 3:30 PM, the Prime Minister invited State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Mir Shahe Alam and DNCC Administrator Md Safiqul Islam to his residence. He also gave necessary instructions to officials responsible for improving civic services.

Driving the vehicle himself, Tarique Rahman visited numerous areas including ECB Chattar, Mirpur DOHS, Diabari, Uttara Sectors 3, 4, 5 and 6, Airport Road, Kakoli, Mohakhali, Farmgate, and Manik Mia Avenue. His route also covered Asad Gate, Mohammadpur, Salimullah Road, Iqbal Road, Tajmahal Road, Japan Garden City, Shyamoli, Gono Bhaban intersection, Zia Udyan, Shewrapara, Kazipara, Mirpur-10, Kachukhet, Cantonment, Sainik Club, and Banani before returning to his Gulshan residence.

According to his Deputy Press Secretary Jahidul Islam Rony, the Prime Minister's personal inspection underscores his repeated commitment to making Dhaka a clean city. He was accompanied by Shahe Alam, Safiqul, BNP Special Secretary Belayet Hossain, and his private secretaries.

During his extensive tour, the Prime Minister identified several problems at different locations and expressed dissatisfaction with a number of issues. He promptly instructed the relevant authorities to take immediate and effective corrective measures.

Prior to the inspection, around 3:30 PM, the Prime Minister invited State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Mir Shahe Alam and DNCC Administrator Md Safiqul Islam to his residence. He also gave necessary instructions to officials responsible for improving civic services.

Driving the vehicle himself, Tarique Rahman visited numerous areas including ECB Chattar, Mirpur DOHS, Diabari, Uttara Sectors 3, 4, 5 and 6, Airport Road, Kakoli, Mohakhali, Farmgate, and Manik Mia Avenue. His route also covered Asad Gate, Mohammadpur, Salimullah Road, Iqbal Road, Tajmahal Road, Japan Garden City, Shyamoli, Gono Bhaban intersection, Zia Udyan, Shewrapara, Kazipara, Mirpur-10, Kachukhet, Cantonment, Sainik Club, and Banani before returning to his Gulshan residence.

According to his Deputy Press Secretary Jahidul Islam Rony, the Prime Minister's personal inspection underscores his repeated commitment to making Dhaka a clean city. He was accompanied by Shahe Alam, Safiqul, BNP Special Secretary Belayet Hossain, and his private secretaries.
